thread_summary: OP asks how to get the full list of public-LB episodes (agent_ids + win/lose/tie). Reply points to the internal gRPC-style API endpoint https://www.kaggle.com/api/i/competitions.EpisodeService/GetEpisode which returns episode data given an episode_id, but does NOT solve the 'list all episode_ids' problem. Final message re-asks the open question: how to get a list of episode_ids for ALL matches. Thread appears unresolved — no answer to the enumeration problem.
